text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from hanging out with 
Daitaku Helios, her phone rang.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, message from a bestie♪ Wonder if they 
wanna hang out with me~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...A guerrilla event?! For real?! Total 
godsend, this is so poggers!
choice_data_list:
Is some celebrity you like coming or 
something?

Is some celebrity you like coming or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yep! My fave DJ's playing. Like, going is 
literally the ONLY option!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
First off, straight to the club in the 
next town!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, a DJ Daitaku Helios likes is 
holding an event... Maybe if I go with 
her, I'll be able to understand her 
better.
choice_data_list: Is it okay if I come with you?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes, totes, toootes~~!! It's gonna be 
totally hype, no doubt!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hehey-heeey! Taxi, pay attention to meee~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, you got on before me?! Total 
wipeout, major sadface~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Time to bust out the Umamusume Road! Check 
it☆
choice_data_list:
I can't run in the Umamusume lane, you 
know...

I can't run in the Umamusume lanes, you 
know...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! I totally forgot, lmao! 
Trai-pi, you're not an Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That is totally off the table~~♪ There's 
no way we're not fessing together!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Train for now! It'll work out somehow!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Tickets for the Special DJ Event are 
completely sold out~! We're so sorry! This 
is totally sold out~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we didn't make it in time for 
the event... Outside the club, you could 
see fans who couldn't get in.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Look at all these people! She really is 
the supreme, charismatic queen of gods~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Btw, those odds are way too brutal, 
totally deflated~. Total sob fest, no 
way~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
So none of you could get in either, huh? 
Total buzzkill.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Daitaku Helios were on her own, she 
could've entered the event. Perhaps I 
really shouldn't have tagged along...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hold up! Looks like it's started, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It's true... Wow, this is seriously so 
good!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
SOOO EMOTIONAL! Peak hype, I'm ascending! 
Live music hits different, no cap!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's wild~!! Seriously, isn't that 
crazy?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The sound inside. Ah, can't hear it, 
Trainie? Right, even for us it's just 
barely audible!
choice_data_list: Sorry for always bringing the mood down...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A mystery apology move?! Trainy, let's 
just get hype for now, k~~?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Seriously goosebumps—or more like crazy 
demon bumps! Next time, I'm definitely 
charging in!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Let's raid it with this crew! 
Wanna get on standby from the morning!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
First thing in the morning is brutal! I'm 
still goin' though. No way I'm letting an 
all-nighter ruin my vibe♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I've got nothing but confidence that we'll 
blow 'em away! I mean, is there anyone who 
CAN'T?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"They're not here, not here! Let's pull a 
fast one on 'em~~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I worried I might have poured cold water 
on things, but I was relieved to see 
Daitaku Helios having fun...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trai-pi! I sent you a video for this 
song! Studying it beforehand is a must!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I played the video Daitaku Helios sent me. 
It was the kind of song that naturally 
made your body move to the rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well? The emotional vibes are totally 
maxed out! Our energy is taking flight, 
isn't it~~?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's turn up the hype right now~~!! Oui, 
oui~~☆
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's such a cool song!
Yeah, it's such an awesome song!
I can't wait to hear it at the club...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's turn up the hype right now~~!! Oui, 
oui~~☆
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's such a cool song!
Yeah, it's such an awesome song!
I can't wait to hear it at the club...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right?! Life's gonna be 10x happier now!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Totally! Keep 'em coming, listen up~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vibing to the music coming from the 
smartphone made me feel like I became part 
of the circle.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You're riding a nice groove down 
there! I'm sendin' you the release 
already!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Put it on repeat all day today♪ Alrighty, 
decided, boom-boom-bam☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I managed to achieve my main goal of 
learning Daitaku Helios's tastes. But next 
time, I wanted to enjoy the music I 
received together with her.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I just got a great idea! I might be a 
genius!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"If we just call a DJ and throw an event, 
everyone'll be hyped in no time, yeah!?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yep, totally god-tier! No doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The venue's gotta be a dome, right?! We 
can pack in a million people! That's totes 
crazy-good!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wonder if that DJ is on LANE?! Maybe I 
should ask! Wait, how would I even do 
that, lol~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios looked so genuinely happy 
talking about her wildly ambitious plan. 
It made me want to join in with her next 
time, too.
